meta.description: Target/SplitInfo/EmitUtils.sendToAcceptors/EnergyUtils.emit(List) with fake handlers, no world. kinds: target (EnergyHandlerTarget with the Collection constructor, sendToAcceptors with a long), target_int (the int overload, saturated result), emit_list (EnergyUtils.emit(List<EnergyHandler>, long)), save (EnergySaveTarget over BasicEnergyContainer, addHandler, inside a root transaction that commits; startSaveHandling zeroes the container), fluid (ResourceHandlerTarget over a one-slot FluidStacksResourceHandler of water).
meta.fields: kind; handlers (cap, max_insert, energy: the initial state, applied to target, target_int, emit_list and save; the fluid tanks always start empty, whatever energy says; max_insert is 0 for save and fluid); order (indexes into handlers, in the order they enter the target, a repeated index is the same object); amount; sent; finals (energy or fluid amount of each handler); calls ([handler, requested, accepted] of every insert, only for target, target_int and emit_list).
